# fixdossier

> Evidence collection and review support for security fixes in GitHub repositories. A free, MIT-licensed GitHub Action (`itulo/fixdossier@v0`) that reads a repository's releases, tags, GitHub Security Advisories (GHSA/CVE), Dependabot/Renovate pull requests, and security-flagged commits to generate a dated record (`SECURITY-RECORD.md`, `security-record.json` schema `fixdossier/v1`) and a support-period policy template (`SUPPORT.md`). Optional hosted workspace and Ed25519-signed Evidence Packs via fixdossier Pro (`https://app.fixdossier.dev`).

Important notes:
- fixdossier is a technical evidence-collection and review-support tool for software maintainers and small vendors preparing for the EU revised Product Liability Directive (Directive (EU) 2024/2853, applicable 9 Dec 2026) and the EU Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847).
- It is not legal advice, not a certification, and not a complete security-fix inventory on its own. Every generated record includes a coverage summary showing advisory-derived vs. heuristic-derived entries, unmatched commits/PRs, and any sources unavailable due to token permissions so a human engineer can review and sign off.

## Quickstart (GitHub Actions)

Add `.github/workflows/fixdossier.yml`:

```yaml
name: fixdossier
on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  security-events: read
  id-token: write        # only required when pro_upload: 'true'

jobs:
  dossier:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: itulo/fixdossier@v0
        with:
          mode: artifact
          pro_upload: 'false'   # set to 'true' to upload to fixdossier Pro via GitHub OIDC
```

## Outputs

- `SECURITY-RECORD.md`: Human-readable dated log of releases, security fixes (GHSA/CVE and heuristic-matched PRs/commits), and a coverage/confidence summary.
- `security-record.json`: Machine-readable record (`"schema": "fixdossier/v1"`).
- `SUPPORT.md`: Draft support-period and vulnerability disclosure policy template with explicit placeholders for human review.

## fixdossier Pro (Optional Hosted Workspace & Signed Evidence Packs)

- URL: https://app.fixdossier.dev (Interactive Demo: https://app.fixdossier.dev/demo)
- Ingests `security-record.json` via short-lived GitHub Actions OIDC (`pro_upload: 'true'`) with zero long-lived repository secrets.
- Provides a multi-repository review queue (`confirmed_security_fix`, `excluded_not_security`, `needs_followup`), append-only audit trail, and Ed25519-signed PDF + ZIP Evidence Packs (`fixdossier-evidence-pack-*.zip`, verifiable at `https://app.fixdossier.dev/api/v1/verify`).
- Founding Licence: €69 one-time for the first 50 GitHub organizations (1 GitHub org, up to 3 repositories and 5 reviewers, active for as long as the service runs, at least 90 days' notice + full 1-click export on shutdown, 14-day EU-standard refund policy).
